title: Great Bay Discovery Center

services.name: Wildlife Watching
services.desc: Great Bay encompasses nearly 25,000 acres of tidal waters and offers numerous viewing platforms, for wildlife and bird watching opportunities. Wildlife photographers and visitors may catch a glimpse of muskrat, white-tailed deer, chipmunk, mink, otter, red fox or cottontail rabbit. There are viewing platforms on the boardwalk at the Great Bay Discovery Center, Great Bay’s Community Wildlife Garden, and on Adam’s Point. The boardwalk at the Discovery Center is universally accessible with a ramp leading to the trail head and a wheelchair accessible boardwalk. services.name: Hunting & Fishing
services.desc: The rich natural resources of Great Bay have provided humans with food and recreation opportunities for thousands of years. Fish, shellfish, waterfowl, and mammals, are found in abundance in and around the estuary and hunting and fishing is a significant part of New Hampshire culture. The Great Bay National Estuarine Research Reserve is part of NH Fish & Game and any Reserve property owned by Fish & Game is open to hunting and fishing. For rules and regulations about hunting and fishing please visit the NH Fish & Game website. Discovery Center Exhibit Room Open Seasonally: May 1st-October 24th, 2026, Tues-Sat, 10am-4pm.
